01 · About

A student-engineer building useful things.

Currently pursuing my Bachelor in Electronics & Communication Engineering at Nepal Engineering College.

Hi — I'm Narayan Pokharel, an Electronics and Communication Engineering student from Bhaktapur, Nepal. I'm passionate about turning ideas into shipped products that solve real problems for real people.

My work lives where AI, mobile development, and embedded systems meet — especially in agriculture, healthcare, and brain-computer interfaces. I love going from a rough whiteboard sketch to a polished Flutter app or a working EEG-driven prototype.

Right now I'm focused on improving AI-powered tools for farmers, developing EEG-based intelligent systems, and going deeper on advanced Flutter and backend integration.

03
03 · Process

How I work with you.

A short, honest process — no waterfall theatre, no vague PMing. Four phases, fast loops, real shipping.

Discover

A short call to understand the problem, the users, the constraint. I'd rather scope down and ship than scope up and stall.

Design

Quick wireframes, then mid-fidelity mocks in Figma. We agree on the shape before code starts — saves weeks later.

Build

Iterative weekly sprints. You see real progress every week, not a black-box reveal at the end. Ship-able from week one.

Deliver

Deploy, document, train. Plus a 30-day window where I'm on tap for bug fixes and small adjustments. Trust over transactions.

08 · Now

What I'm doing right now.

Inspired by Derek Sivers' /now page — a snapshot of what's actually in motion this season.

Live · Updated May 2026

Final year of engineering, shipping in parallel.

I'm in my final semesters at Nepal Engineering College, balancing thesis work with active builds. Aiming for graduate studies abroad — Germany is high on the list.

  • 🌾Shipping Khetala v2 — adding an offline AI assistant and Nepali voice input so farmers without strong connectivity still get useful advice.
  • 🧠Writing my thesis on EEG signal classification using lightweight neural networks — focused on running inference on consumer-grade hardware.
  • 🇩🇪Learning German (A1 → A2) for graduate-school applications. Built my own trilingual app to make the daily practice stick.
  • 📡Researching antenna design for low-cost IoT devices targeted at remote agricultural monitoring.
  • 🎓Applying to master's programmes in EE / AI / Computational Neuroscience — Germany, Netherlands, and South Korea on the shortlist.
  • ☕Always open to coffee chats with founders, fellow students, and engineers working on agri-tech or healthcare in Nepal.
